description: ChatGPT/Muse/Grok-facing MCP for brand storefronts: photo → mesh → products → quote → Shopify checkout

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: List products for a store (gift/custom figurines, hobby gifts, etc). Use when the user wants to browse what they can order. Returns name, sku, summary, price tier — not internal costs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.title: Get product details
tools.description: Full public details for one product: summary, personalisation questions, fulfilment blurb, public image URL. Use before quoting or ordering.

tools.name: upload_photo
tools.title: Upload person or pet photo
tools.description: Upload a photo of a person or pet to start a custom figurine pipeline. Returns photo_id for status checks. Does not spend credits or order yet.

tools.name: get_photo_status
tools.title: Photo and mesh status
tools.description: Machine-readable view of an uploaded photo and any mesh/preview job. Use to show the customer what was detected and whether the mesh is ready.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Get price and fulfilment quote
tools.description: Price tier and fulfilment estimate for a product with optional personalisation. Use after the customer chooses a product — always show price before checkout.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.title: Start Shopify checkout
tools.description: Reserve an order and return an external checkout URL on our store (Shopify). Physical goods only. Does not charge the card in-chat.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Get order status
tools.description: Look up status by order_ref returned from start_checkout.
